title: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 Review | Stadium Merdeka, KL
meta_description: Pos Malaysia Run review: 7,000+ runners at Stadium Merdeka on 22 November 2025, race kits delivered by post, a new relay and an OKU category.
dek: Pos Malaysia's run doubled in size in its second year, with more than 7,000 runners at Stadium Merdeka in November 2025. Here is what it was like, including one runner's account.
verdict: The Pos Malaysia Run is a fun 10 km in the heart of Kuala Lumpur. Its second edition, on 22 November 2025, drew more than 7,000 participants to Stadium Merdeka, double the 3,500 of the first year [1]. It offered a 10 km, a new 10 km corporate relay, a 5.8 km fun run and a special category for runners with disabilities [1]. Fittingly for a postal service, race kits were delivered to runners' homes, which one runner who took part called really convenient, especially for anyone travelling from outside the Klang Valley [1]. If you want a friendly 10 km in central KL, it is a good choice.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The second Pos Malaysia Run was held on 22 November 2025 at Stadium Merdeka, under the theme Jom Laju for Fun, with FWD as main partner [1]. More than 7,000 participants took part, up from 3,500 at the first edition in 2024 [1].
The deputy communications minister, Teo Nie Ching, flagged off the 10 km and corporate relay at 6.30am and also took part in the 10 km [1]. The start line faced Merdeka 118 [1].

sections.heading: Categories and Kit
paragraphs: There was a 10 km, a new 10 km corporate relay for pairs running 5 km each, a 5.8 km fun run, and a special category for persons with disabilities (OKU) [1].

Race kits were delivered to participants' addresses rather than collected at a venue, which the runner who wrote about the race called really convenient, especially for anyone travelling from outside the Klang Valley [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want an easy-to-join 10 km at a historic venue in central Kuala Lumpur, with no race-pack queue to worry about.
It is not a long race: the longest distance is 10 km. If you want a half marathon, this is not it.
This review is compiled from a runner's own account of the 2025 edition, which also reproduces the organiser's summary. It is not a race report by this site, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Pos Malaysia Run in 2025?
faqs.answer: More than 7,000 participants took part on 22 November 2025 at Stadium Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, double the 3,500 at the first edition in 2024.

faqs.question: What distances does the Pos Malaysia Run offer?
faqs.answer: In 2025: a 10 km, a 10 km corporate relay run as two 5 km legs, a 5.8 km fun run for individuals and groups of four, and a special category for persons with disabilities.

faqs.question: Do you have to collect a race kit for the Pos Malaysia Run?
faqs.answer: No. In 2025 race kits were delivered to participants' addresses, which one runner described as really convenient, especially for those travelling from outside the Klang Valley.
